description: Eight screenshot-led Theme Studio benchmark cases: two public Shopify theme demo stores per industry. Screenshots are captured locally by scripts/theme-studio-benchmark-references.mjs into a git-ignored folder and are never committed. The briefs ask for an original store that follows the reference's design, never its brand, copy, logo or photography.

cases.brief: Build an original fashion and apparel store with its own brand name and voice. Use the attached screenshots as the design reference: follow their layout, section order, visual hierarchy, colour palette, typography mood, spacing and photography style as closely as StoreMink sections allow. Do not copy the reference's brand name, logo, wording or product photos. Eight realistic products with size and colour options, collection discovery and a concise about page.
